senses.gloss: (denom. of a noun מַסָּק, fr. נסק to ascend) to harvest olives, opp. to נקף to pick, glean.
units: <cite ref="Tosefta Demai 6:6">Tosef. Dem. VI, 6</cite> <he>ישראל שקיבל … זיתיו לִמְסוֹק בזתים</he> if an Israelite rented from a fellow Israelite … his olive trees for harvesting, the rent to be payable in olives; <he>זיתיו למסוק בשמן</he> payable in oil; Y. ib. VI, 25ᵇ top.
<cite ref="Mishnah Negaim 2:4">Neg. II, 4</cite> <he>כמוֹסֵק וכ׳</he> in the position of one taking olives down.
<cite ref="Tosefta Tahorot 10:4">Tosef. Toh. X, 4</cite> <he>עד שלא מְסָקָן</he> before he plucked them; a. fr.—Part. pass. <he>מָסוּק</he>; pl. <he>מְסוּקִין</he>.
<cite ref="Tosefta Bava Metzia 9:1">Tosef. B. Mets. IX, 1</cite>.—Denom. <cite ref="M01927"><he>מָסִיק</he></cite>, <cite ref="M01932"><he>מְסִיקָה</he></cite>.
